title.zh: IER 重新分级：奥地利 AUT-01 队核定重型

summary.en: The Austrian Forces Disaster Relief Unit (AFDRU) Team (AUT-01) has been successfully reclassified as Heavy USAR team following the reclassification process conducted from 5 to 9 October 2026 in Austria. The INSARAG Secretariat extends its sincerest congratulations.
summary.zh: 奥地利武装部队灾害救援分队（AFDRU，AUT-01）于2026年10月5日至9日在奥地利完成重新分级认证，被核定为重型城市搜索与救援队。

content.en: The Austrian Forces Disaster Relief Unit (AFDRU) Team (AUT-01) has been successfully reclassified as Heavy USAR team following the reclassification process conducted from 5 to 9 October 2026 in Austria. The INSARAG Secretariat extends its sincerest congratulations.
content.zh: 奥地利武装部队灾害救援分队（AFDRU，编号 AUT-01）于2026年10月5日至9日在奥地利境内完成重新分级认证，被核定为重型城市搜索与救援队。INSARAG 秘书处向该队致以最诚挚的祝贺。
